name: aye
description: Lightweight AI-pair workflow skills: scope alignment, acceptance criteria, pull-based iteration. Designed for solo dev + AI pair programming, not team Scrum.

interface.shortDescription: Scope, acceptance, and review workflows for AI pair programming
interface.longDescription: Aye provides lightweight workflow skills for solo developer and AI pair programming: clarify features, align implementation scope, define executable acceptance criteria, review changes, and gate commits without adopting heavyweight team Scrum rituals.
defaultPrompt: Use aye flow to show the workflow map.
Use aye feature to clarify this new feature.
Use aye scope before implementing this task.
